title: Cycle Legal Check
user: Cyclists riding speed pedelecs or crossing local restrictions who need a pre-ride explanation of where their GPX/profile conflicts with route access rules.
smallest_useful_product: A GPX analyzer that compares route edges against selected vehicle class and region rules, highlights access conflicts/unknowns, links to underlying OSM tags, and exports a review checklist.
constraints: Not legal advice; record rule-source dates; comply with OSM attribution and data licenses; do not claim complete coverage.
